questions.stem: What does a pyramid of biomass show?

options.text: The number of organisms at each trophic level
The mass of living material at each trophic level
The energy used by each organism
The height of organisms in the food chain

questions.explanation: A pyramid of biomass shows the total mass of living material (biomass) at each trophic level. It generally decreases at each higher level because energy is lost between levels.
